definitions.going: AW by explicit surface first; otherwise any soft/heavy substring including in-places labels; other nonempty or unmapped empty. Not a severity measure.
definitions.course: Any runner has any used history with course similarity exactly1; not every runner or a measured course advantage.
definitions.last_run: Median across runners of days between target date and most recent used historic date; not an independent fitness measurement.
definitions.ranking: Descending frozen probability; archive runner order breaks exact ties. Beta stage invariant.
definitions.scope: All bins partition exact same76races per axis; overlaps between axes are confounded. Small-bin flag n<10 is descriptive. No p-values or subgroup retuning.
